text:
gokul: Heads-up — pushing engine:v2-kernel+quant (build b20260319) to the night window. Staged rollforward planned for 02:00 UTC tonight. tagging owners: @carla @ben
carla: smoke pass in staging: mem, perf, kv-cache looks ok. small perf regression ~2% at 8k tokens. logs attached. :white_check_mark:
ben: can we run the offload/quantized path soak on p3-16 before canary? last time we saw thermal on long seqs
gokul: yes, running synthetic long-seq soak on p3-16 now, will paste summary in ~15m
deploybot: deploy scheduled: engine:v2-kernel-quant-b20260319 -> canary (5% traffic) at 02:00 UTC, roll policy: linear 5->25->100 over 30m, auto-rollback on 3x error-rate or latency +30% sustained 5m
alice: agree on rollback triggers: if 95th latency > +30% for 10m or error-rate > 0.5% increase vs baseline -> rollback
carla: also add health-check: kv-cache miss rate spike > 2x is a hard abort
ben: note: pin TTL for sticky fallback should be 2h, ops_sam to coordinate cross-region pin
ops_sam: got it. I'll prepare pin keys and the release-note blurb for SRE runbook
gokul: release notes draft for changelog: "engine v2 kernel: quant path improvements, perf parity on short seqs, reduced memory footprint". Known issue: "thermal regressions on 16k+ sequences on some instances; auto-pin/fallback will trigger."
carla: pre-rollback playbook snippet:
```
# if auto-rollback triggers
/deploy rollback engine:v2 -> engine:v1 --reason=\"latency spike\" --notify=#incidents
/pin engine:v1 --ttl=2h --scope=region-eu
```
ben: suggest adding a manual hold command to pause traffic shift: `/deploy hold --thread 3901234567`
gokul: copy. will update PR and attach release note. if no red flags 1h post-rollout we'll unpin and close the thread :thumbsup:
deploybot: canary started at 02:00:15 UTC (canary-id cb-20260319-1) — monitoring hooks live
alice: monitoring looks green so far. long-seq soak still running, will report by +40m
ops_sam: I'm on standby for cross-region pin if needed
carla: if we see KV leak, remember to set cache eviction to aggressive and hold rollout
gokul: final: tagging docs-team for changelog: @marie
